purpose: make sure each person and system has only the access it needs, and that access is reviewed and removable
entry_criteria: Systems in scope and their access owners are listed
Current access export can be obtained from each system
Access policy defines roles and review cadence
procedure: Export current entitlements per system and map each account to a named person or service owner.
Compare entitlements with the role definitions; flag excess, dormant and orphaned accounts.
Send each access owner their list for confirm or revoke; set a deadline.
Apply revocations through the normal change path; keep the ticket id for each.
Verify by re-export that revoked access is gone.
Record completion, exceptions with expiry, and the next review date; access-owner approves.
acceptance_criteria: Every account has an owner and a role justification
Dormant and orphaned accounts are removed or excepted

validation.expect: only the requested revocations appear as removed lines; no additions

failure_modes.detection: Zero changes across a large population

failure_modes.response: Assign an owner or disable the account

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A quarterly review of the deployment tool finds two departed contractors with admin rights and one service account with no owner. Admin rights are revoked, the service account is assigned to the platform team, and re-export confirms it.
